_comment: Paths for the laptop object accuracy test (scripts/laptop/object_test.py and object_live.py). Test only: brim never reads this file. The test reads the COCO-to-Thing mapping from mapping_source and the confidence and closeness thresholds from safety_config and the left/ahead/right split from nav_config (all read-only), so it scores exactly what the hat would see. Paths are relative to the repo root; data_dir is git-ignored.
